test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of following is the world's largest food security programme extended till September 2022 by the Union Cabinet, Government of India in March 2022?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is** __'__**__**Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana'**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Food Security Act**,2013 (NFSA 2013) converts into legal entitlements for the existing food security program of the Government of India.
 
• Food security, as defined by the United Nations Committee on **World Food Security**, means that all people, at all times, have physical, social, and economic access to sufficient, safe, and nutritious food that meets their food preferences and dietary needs for an active and healthy life.
 
• The world's largest food security program which has been extended till September 2022, is **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PMGKAY** is a part of the **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package (PMGKP)** to help the poor fight the battle against Covid-19.
 
• The scheme aimed at providing each person who is covered under the **National Food Security Act 2013** with an additional 5 kg of grains (wheat or rice) for free, in addition to the 5 kg of subsidized food grain already provided through the **Public Distribution System (PDS).**
